# One template per block; {k} is replaced by each word of words.txt.
=== dim bas
Sub Probe()
    Dim {k} As Long
End Sub
=== assign bas
Sub Probe()
    {k} = 1
End Sub
=== use bas
Sub Probe()
    x = {k} + 1
End Sub
=== call bas
Sub Probe()
    {k} 1
End Sub
=== sub bas
Sub {k}()
End Sub
=== param bas
Sub Probe({k} As Long)
End Sub
=== label bas
Sub Probe()
    GoTo {k}
{k}:
End Sub
=== member bas
Sub Probe(o As Object)
    x = o.{k}
End Sub
=== moddim bas
Dim {k} As Long
=== typemember bas
Type T
    {k} As Long
End Type
